convertibility_reason: Uses pending order management with expiration, hedging account requirement, multiple time window filters with once-per-window gate logic, and raw candle pattern recognition (no standard indicators). Pending order placement and expiration management adds complexity beyond simple market entry.

derived_values.name: m_adjusted_point
derived_values.formula: m_symbol.Point() * 10 when Digits==3 or Digits==5, else m_symbol.Point()

long.left: Bar[2] bearish body >= 20 points AND Bar[2] close <= Bar[1] open AND Bar[1] close > Bar[2] open AND Bar[1] body >= 0.4*ExtCandleSize

other_exits: Pending orders expire after 4 hours (ORDER_TIME_SPECIFIED with TimeCurrent()+4*60*60)
Time window gate resets trade flag when outside all 6 time windows, preventing new orders but not closing existing ones

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Free margin must be >= 1000*Lots, otherwise order is not placed

custom_logic_notes: Time-filter uses 6 specific start times (0:05, 4:05, 8:05, 12:05, 16:05, 20:05) each allowing a 5-minute (300 second) window. The 'trade' boolean flag ensures only ONE order per window across ALL windows. Once trade=true, no more orders until all windows pass and flag resets. BuyLimit placed at Ask - ExtIndentUP (16 pips below Ask). SellLimit placed at Bid + ExtIndentUP (16 pips above Bid) - note code uses ExtIndentUP for SellLimit too despite InpIndentDOWN=20 being defined but ExtIndentDOWN never used in order placement. Hedging account is REQUIRED - EA fails initialization on netting accounts. IsBadBull filter prevents entry when 3 consecutive large bullish bars exist (potential overbought). IsCoolBull detects a bullish reversal pattern: bearish bar[2] followed by bullish bar[1] that engulfs bar[2] open.
python_conversion_notes: Pending order management with expiration is the primary complexity. Must implement: (1) 6 time-window gate with once-per-window trade flag, (2) BuyLimit/SellLimit placement with SL/TP relative to limit price not market price, (3) 4-hour order expiration, (4) hedging-mode position tracking by magic number. Note: ExtIndentDOWN is calculated but never used - SellLimit uses ExtIndentUP (InpIndentUP=16) not ExtIndentDOWN (InpIndentDOWN=20). Candle pattern functions use iClose/iOpen comparisons with specific bar shifts [1],[2],[3] - these are lookback-relative, not current-bar. The position gate checks pending orders only (not open positions), so it can stack positions if pending orders fill and new window opens.
